messages:
Maria: heads up — canary A/B rollout (variant A2) opened an alert. p50 +10%, p95 +22%, p99 +35% on text-gen path. CI perf check for PR #3892 failed too. Saved traces to /tmp/canary-trace-1769876500

Devon: saw it. Canary still at 20% traffic. Did we pin a new kernel selector in that PR?

Maria: PR 3892 touched kernel-selection heuristics + batching default. Bisect points at commit 7f3a2b4 (kernel-heuristic-weight tweak). No revert yet.

Ryan: I ran perf profile on a canary replica. KV cache hit-rate went from 98% -> 71% for our multi-turn bench. That explains the token churn. Also observed micro-batch sizes shrinking on steady traffic, which raised per-request overhead.

Ryan: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-18 09:02:14] batcher: optimal_batch=16 current=4 overhead_ms=8.2
[2026-03-18 09:02:15] kvcache: hits=710 misses=290 hit_rate=0.71
[2026-03-18 09:02:16] kernel-selector: chosen=fp16_fast_gemm reason=heuristic_score=0.42
```

ci-bot: PERF CHECK FAILED — PR #3892
- p99 generation latency regressed by 34%
- perf diff: https://ci.redwood/pulls/3892/diff

Aisha: we should pause the rollout and trigger the auto-revert if p99 > SLO*1.2 for >= 5m. That matches the new canary gating doc.

Devon: agreed. Pausing now. ops-bot: pause rollout A2 (id: rollout-4217)

ops-bot: rollout rollout-4217 paused by Devon at 2026-03-18T09:05:02Z :heavy_check_mark:

Maria: re: bisect — I can run a focused bisect on kernel-selector changes vs batching defaults. If kernel selector is picking a slower kernel because of the heuristic weight, we can force fallback to previous selector while we fix.

Ryan: we also need to examine KV eviction behavior. The heuristic tweak preferred kernels that increase peak memory, causing earlier KV evictions for long contexts. That explains hit-rate drop.

Devon: plan:
1) temporarily pin kernel-selector to previous stable hash (revert heuristic delta) in canary A2 config to validate
2) enable KV-cache logging for longer traces and run synthetic multi-turn suite
3) re-run batcher tuning in staging with traffic shape to avoid micro-batch shrink
4) if step 1 eliminates regression, promote a targeted revert + patch

Maria: I'll open issue and assign. Creating issue: ENG-RT-682: "kernel-selector heuristic caused KV eviction & batching shrink -> canary perf regression"

Maria: added links to traces and profiler heatmap in the issue. tagging @Ryan @Devon @Aisha

Ryan: quick experiment: forcing kernel-selector to prefer low-mem kernels restored hit_rate to 96% in a short run. So regression is likely an interaction (selector + mem footprint).

Aisha: for rollout guardrails: propose adding a canary SLO gate rule:
- metric: p99 generation latency
- window: 5m
- threshold: +20% relative to baseline
- action: auto-pause + rollback candidate variant after 10m if no improvement
also add KV cache hit_rate as a secondary metric with threshold -10% absolute drop

Devon: add that to the canary gating config and CI perf job; CI should run a short multi-turn workload for every runtime-affecting PR (kernel, batching, cache) before merge.

ops-bot: note: automated rollback policy configured (canary_gates_v2) - will apply if rule is tripped and owner doesn't respond within 10m.

Maria: I'm going to pin a hotfix config on canary A2 reverting the selector weight and re-run the canary tests. If perf is green, we'll ship a targeted revert + follow-up patch that adjusts mem footprint estimation.

Devon: thanks. If bisect shows multiple commits involved, we'll do a split revert: selector heuristic first, batching default next.

Samir: logging note — canary traces have a lot of noise from a/b routing. Recommend we tag trace spans with variant=A1/A2 to make diffing easier.

Maria: good call. I'll update tracing filter.

Ryan: one more thing — add a CI perf check that simulates KV pressure by increasing sequence length distribution. That caught this reg locally.

Aisha: assigning owners: Devon (rollback & gating config), Ryan (kv + kernel profiling), Maria (issue + canary hotfix), Samir (tracing). Ops will watch.

ops-bot: rollout-4217 remains paused. Auto-rollback armed. Will revert candidate if no remedial patch within 10m after unpause.

Maria: thanks all. I'll post updates in this thread after the bisect and hotfix run. :pray:
